themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Spike
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints surged to 10 this week, up 248% from the 2.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.91), signaling a potential emerging public safety crisis in Morningside Heights that warrants immediate investigation into whether this reflects actual increased street-level activity or enforcement changes.
evidence: 10 drug activity complaints THIS WEEK vs 2.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
248% increase represents statistically significant deviation (z-score: 4.91, severity: high)
Concurrent spike in Non-Emergency Police Matters (8 complaints THIS WEEK vs 2.5 avg, up 220%)
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD 25th Precinct about any recent enforcement operations or community intelligence driving the spike
Canvass local residents, merchants, and Columbia University security about observable changes in street-level drug activity in past 7-10 days

themes_detail.label: Street Lighting Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street light condition complaints exploded to 32 last week, up 433% from the 6.0 weekly average (z-score: 11.93), representing the most statistically anomalous spike in the dataset and potentially indicating a major infrastructure failure or widespread maintenance backlog affecting public safety and quality of life.
evidence: 32 street light complaints LAST WEEK vs 6.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
433% spike is the largest statistical anomaly in entire dataset (z-score: 11.93, highest severity rating)
Aligns with long-standing CB budget requests for transit/infrastructure repair (DOT capital requests)
reporting_angles: Contact DOT to identify which blocks or corridors are experiencing outages and timeline for repairs
Interview residents about how street lighting outages affect safety perceptions, evening foot traffic, and sense of security

themes_detail.label: Vendor Enforcement Surge
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints jumped to 9 this week, up 620% from the 1.2 weekly average (z-score: 7.11), suggesting either a sudden crackdown by enforcement agencies, proliferation of unlicensed street vending, or both in a neighborhood with significant commercial foot traffic.
evidence: 9 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Morningside Heights includes major retail corridors (Amsterdam Avenue, 125th Street) and Columbia University-adjacent areas with heavy street commerce
reporting_angles: Determine if DSNY or other city agencies launched a coordinated enforcement sweep this week
Interview street vendors and local business associations about recent enforcement activity and its impact on livelihoods

themes_detail.label: Water Quality Alert
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints spiked to 3 last week, up 1100% from a near-zero 0.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 6.35), a rare but potentially serious signal that could indicate contamination, discoloration, or taste/odor issues affecting multiple buildings or a water main problem.
evidence: 3 water quality complaints LAST WEEK vs 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
1100% increase with z-score of 6.35 represents extremely rare anomaly in water quality baseline
Occurs amid broader plumbing complaints (717 over 90 days) suggesting possible infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Environmental Protection to check for water main breaks, boil water advisories, or quality tests in Morningside Heights zip codes
Reach out to residents who filed complaints to document what water quality issues they observed (color, smell, taste) and which buildings/addresses were affected

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints reached 9 last week, up 167% from the 3.4 weekly average (z-score: 2.91), suggesting possible enforcement gaps or temporary increases in construction/renovation waste from the 367 DOB permits filed in the district.
evidence: 9 illegal dumping complaints LAST WEEK vs 3.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
167% increase with z-score of 2.91 meets high-severity threshold
Temporal correlation with 328 alteration permits filed in past 90 days suggests construction debris may be contributor
reporting_angles: Map illegal dumping complaint locations against active DOB construction permits to assess correlation
Interview DSNY about enforcement capacity and whether specific corridors or blocks are hotspots for dumping
